models.notes: OpenAI blog and paper 'Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training', 2018-06-11 (Epoch lists 2018-06-01). 117M-param decoder-only transformer pretrained on BookCorpus, then fine-tuned per task; code and weights were published on GitHub under MIT (openai/finetune-transformer-lm). GLUE 72.8 vs the previous best 68.9 (the paper's headline claim, also repeated on Wikipedia). Not evaluated on SQuAD v1.1; MMLU did not exist yet. Training compute 1.76e19 FLOP is Epoch's forward-pass estimate (confidence 'Likely', ~1 month on 8 GPUs, 100 epochs); Epoch also cites 5.7e19 from the 'AI and Memory Wall' analysis. No API, no price. Arena Elo 550 is a pure extrapolation far below the Jan-2025 LMArena floor (raw LLaMA-13B = 800); GPT-1 was never chat-tested, so treat it as a game-balance number.

Announced 2019-02-14 with the 124M model released and the full model withheld (staged release): 355M followed around May 2019, 774M on 2019-08-20, and the full 1.5B weights on 2019-11-05 (open, modified MIT licence). The date used is the first public GPT-2 weights; the stats are for the 1.5B model (1542M params in the paper, trained on WebText, ~40 GB / 8M pages). Epoch (confidence 'Speculative') puts compute at 1.92e21 FLOP, assuming 20 epochs (12 is the modal value, since the epoch count was never reported). MMLU 32.4% is GPT-2 1.5B fine-tuned on UnifiedQA multiple-choice data plus the MMLU dev/val sets (Hendrycks et al. 2020, Table 1; chance is 25%). Never reported on SQuAD v1.1 or GLUE. Zero-shot results re-checked in the GPT-2 paper: LAMBADA accuracy 63.24% (perplexity 8.63) and CoQA 55 F1 on the dev set. No API or price. Arena Elo 650 is an extrapolation, never chat-tested.

Paper on arXiv 2020-05-28; the API private beta opened 2020-06-11, which is used as the release date. The beta was free; press reported on 2020-09-03 that paid plans would start on 2020-10-01 (per-engine prices for 2020 not directly checked). Davinci list price was $0.06 per 1K tokens ($60 per 1M, input and output) until the cut to $0.02 on 2022-09-01 (confirmed by OpenAI's community announcement and press; the same cut took Curie 0.006->0.002, Babbage 0.0012->0.0005, Ada 0.0008->0.0004). 174.6B params, trained on ~300B tokens drawn from a ~499B-token mixed corpus, 3.14e23 FLOP (Epoch, 'Confident'). MMLU 43.9% is 5-shot (Hendrycks et al. 2020, Table 1; 37.7% zero-shot; chance 25%). HumanEval 0% is from the Codex paper ('GPT-3 solves 0%'). No SQuAD v1.1 or GLUE in the paper (it reports SQuAD v2 and SuperGLUE instead). Fine-tuned GSM8K figures exist (~33% for 175B finetuned, ~55% with a verifier, read off Cobbe et al. 2021, not re-checked) but are not a native few-shot score, so GSM8K is left null. The paper discloses a filtering bug in its contamination analysis with minimal effect, so the flag stays false. Arena Elo 800 is an extrapolation (base model, never chat-tested): set equal to the raw LLaMA-13B base (800, MMLU ~47 vs GPT-3's 43.9) on the 2025-01-24 LMArena snapshot.

Paper 'Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code' (arXiv July 2021; Epoch date 2021-07-07). GitHub Copilot's technical preview ran on a Codex descendant from 2021-06-29. The OpenAI Codex API private beta (the release date used here) opened 2021-08-10 and was free during the beta, never sold at a list price, hence api=false and no price. 12B GPT-3-family model fine-tuned on ~159 GB of filtered GitHub Python. HumanEval pass@1 28.8% for Codex-12B (GPT-3 0%, GPT-J 11.4%), pass@100 72.3% in Table 1 (the abstract says 70.2% with 100 samples). Codex-S (supervised fine-tune) reaches 37.7% pass@1 and 77.5% pass@100 (oracle: at least one of 100 samples passes the unit tests); picking the sample with the highest mean log-probability, which needs no tests, gives 44.5%. Later code-davinci-002 (2022-03-15) scores ~47% pass@1 per the Chain-of-Thought Hub (third-party). Compute 7.344e22 FLOP is Epoch's estimate (confidence 'Likely') from the paper's statement that GPT-3-12B pretraining and the Codex fine-tune each used 'hundreds of petaflop/s-days' (taken as ~425 PF-days each). Arena Elo 750 is a pure extrapolation; this is a code model, not a chat model.

2022-01-27 is the date OpenAI made the InstructGPT models (1.3B, 6B and 175B, RLHF-tuned GPT-3) the API default; the paper (arXiv 2203.02155) followed on 2022-03-04. The text-davinci-002 variant (built on code-davinci-002) shipped 2022-03-15, and text-davinci-003 on 2022-11-28. Davinci-tier price was $0.06 per 1K tokens ($60 per 1M) until the cut to $0.02 on 2022-09-01. Compute 3.19e23 FLOP is Epoch's figure (confidence 'Confident'): GPT-3's 3.14e23 plus ~1.65% for PPO-ptx (60 vs 3,640 petaflop/s-days). MMLU 60.0 (5-shot) and GSM8K 55.4 (8-shot CoT) are for text-davinci-002, a later snapshot than the release date, from the Chain-of-Thought Hub (a third-party aggregation). HumanEval is null for text-davinci-002; its parent code-davinci-002 is ~47.0. Arena Elo 920 is an extrapolation (these models were never on LMArena), anchored to Alpaca-13B (902, distilled from text-davinci-003) and RWKV-4-Raven-14B (922) on the 2025-01-24 snapshot.

Released 2022-11-28 (two days before ChatGPT) as the flagship of the GPT-3.5 series completion models, at $0.02 per 1K tokens ($20 per 1M) for prompt and completion, the same as the other Davinci models after the Sept 2022 cut; deprecated in January 2024. Parameter count undisclosed (Epoch speculates 175B for the series). MMLU 64.6 is from the third-party Chain-of-Thought Hub; that table has no GSM8K or HumanEval entry for it. Training compute 2.578e24 FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate for the GPT-3.5 series (its 'GPT-3.5 (davinci-002)' row dated 2022-03-15); Epoch's own davinci-003 row has no compute figure. Arena Elo 960 is an extrapolation (never on LMArena), placed between Alpaca-13B (902, distilled from this model) and gpt-3.5-turbo-0314 (1107) on the 2025-01-24 snapshot.

Launched 2022-11-30 as a free research preview, fine-tuned with RLHF from a GPT-3.5-series model. ChatGPT Plus ($20/month) started 2023-02-01 and there was no per-token API until gpt-3.5-turbo on 2023-03-01 (next entry). OpenAI published no benchmarks for the Nov 2022 model. Scores shown are the 'GPT-3.5' baseline in the GPT-4 Technical Report (March 2023, run on a ChatGPT snapshot): MMLU 70.0 (5-shot), HumanEval 48.1 (0-shot), GSM8K 57.1 (5-shot). GPQA Diamond 28.1 is GPT-3.5-turbo-16k zero-shot CoT from the GPQA paper (Table 6: 30.6 zero-shot, 26.0 few-shot, 29.6 few-shot CoT). The launch model was probably a few points lower. Parameter count was never disclosed; the 20B figure in Microsoft's CODEFUSION paper was reportedly retracted (per Epoch). Compute 2.578e24 FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate for the GPT-3.5 series (its 'GPT-3.5 (davinci-002)' row dated 2022-03-15), not specific to the ChatGPT fine-tune. Arena Elo 1090 is an estimate: the Nov 2022 model was never on LMArena, and gpt-3.5-turbo-0314 sits at 1107 on the 2025-01-24 snapshot.

ChatGPT API (gpt-3.5-turbo-0301) launched 2023-03-01 at $0.002 per 1K tokens, i.e. $2 per 1M for both input and output, 10x cheaper than text-davinci-003. Later cuts (from memory, not re-checked): $1.5 in / $2 out (June 2023), $1 / $2 (Nov 2023), $0.5 / $1.5 (Jan 2024). MMLU 70.0, HumanEval 48.1 and GSM8K 57.1 are the GPT-3.5 baseline in the GPT-4 Technical Report (the same figures as the ChatGPT entry). GPQA Diamond 28.1 is gpt-3.5-turbo-16k zero-shot CoT from the GPQA paper. For comparison, Meta measured a later 3.5-Turbo at MMLU 70.7 (5-shot), GSM8K 81.6, HumanEval 68.0 and GPQA 30.8 (Llama 3.1 paper), and the Chain-of-Thought Hub's own run gives MMLU 67.3 and GSM8K 74.9. Params and compute undisclosed: Epoch lists ~20B from Microsoft's CODEFUSION paper, which was reportedly retracted, and gives no compute estimate. Arena Elo 1107 is gpt-3.5-turbo-0314 on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off); the 0613 snapshot is at 1117 and 0125 at 1106.

Released 2023-03-14 (Epoch dates it 03-15). 8K context was $0.03 per 1K prompt tokens and $0.06 per 1K completion tokens ($30 / $60 per 1M); 32K was $60 / $120. Benchmarks are from the GPT-4 Technical Report: MMLU 86.4 (5-shot), HumanEval 67.0 (0-shot), GSM8K 92.0 (5-shot CoT). GPQA Diamond 35.7 is zero-shot CoT from the GPQA paper (34.2 zero-shot, 38.8 few-shot CoT). Parameter count is NOT official: 1.8T MoE (~280B active) is the SemiAnalysis leak that Epoch lists as unconfirmed ('Likely'). Compute 2.1e25 FLOP is Epoch's rough estimate (90% CI 8.2e24 to 4.4e25). Contamination flag: the report discloses that part of the GSM8K training set was in the pretraining mix, and its Table 11 shows 25% of HumanEval problems overlapping the training data (GPT-4 scores 65.6% on the uncontaminated subset vs 67.0% overall). Arena Elo 1186 is gpt-4-0314 on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off).

Announced at DevDay 2023-11-06 (gpt-4-1106-preview) with a 128K context at $0.01 per 1K input and $0.03 per 1K output ($10 / $30 per 1M), 3x and 2x cheaper than GPT-4. MMLU 84.7, GPQA 42.5 and HumanEval 83.7 are OpenAI simple-evals for gpt-4-1106-preview (assistant prompt). GSM8K 94.2 (8-shot CoT) is Meta's measurement of the later gpt-4-0125-preview in the Llama 3.1 paper, so it is third-party and a different snapshot. The 2024-04-09 GA version scores MMLU 86.7, GPQA 49.3 and HumanEval 88.2 (simple-evals) and has Arena Elo 1256. Parameters undisclosed. Compute 2.2e25 FLOP is Epoch's imputation from benchmark scores (confidence 'Unknown'). Arena Elo 1250 is gpt-4-1106-preview on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off).

Released 2024-05-13 at $5 per 1M input and $15 per 1M output; the price fell to $2.50 / $10 with gpt-4o-2024-08-06. MMLU 88.7 (0-shot CoT), GPQA 53.6 and HumanEval 90.2 are the launch-blog figures, which Meta's Llama 3.1 paper also lists for GPT-4o; the current simple-evals README (assistant prompt) re-run shows 87.2 / 49.9 / 91.0. GSM8K 96.1 (8-shot CoT) is Meta's measurement from the Llama 3.1 paper (third-party). SWE-bench Verified 33.2% is from OpenAI's Aug 2024 SWE-bench Verified post (best open scaffold; repeated in the o1 system card), so it post-dates the release. Params undisclosed. Compute 3.8e25 FLOP is Epoch's speculative imputation from benchmark scores. Arena Elo 1285 is gpt-4o-2024-05-13 on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off); gpt-4o-2024-08-06 is 1265 and chatgpt-4o-latest (2024-11-20) reached 1365 on the same snapshot.

Released 2024-07-18 at $0.15 per 1M input and $0.60 per 1M output, replacing GPT-3.5 in ChatGPT. MMLU 82.0, GPQA 40.2 and HumanEval 87.2 match OpenAI's simple-evals table (MATH 70.2, MGSM 87.0). GSM8K was not reported, so it is null. Params undisclosed. Compute 7.36e24 FLOP is Epoch's speculative estimate (90% CI 3.2e24 to 2.05e25). Arena Elo 1273 is gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off).

Released 2024-09-12 in ChatGPT and in the API for tier-5 developers at $15 per 1M input and $60 per 1M output; hidden reasoning tokens are billed as output. MMLU 90.8, GPQA Diamond 73.3 and HumanEval 92.4 are OpenAI simple-evals (MATH-500 85.5, MGSM 90.8). SWE-bench Verified 41.4% is the final o1-preview per the Sept 2024 o1 system card (5-try Agentless scaffold); the Dec 2024 card lists 41.3. GSM8K is not reported. Params and compute undisclosed (Epoch lists neither). Arena Elo 1335 is o1-preview on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off).

Released 2024-09-12 alongside o1-preview at $3 per 1M input and $12 per 1M output (80% cheaper than o1-preview), a smaller reasoning model aimed at STEM and coding, first offered to ChatGPT Plus and Team users. MMLU 85.2, GPQA 60.0 and HumanEval 92.4 are simple-evals (MATH-500 90.0). SWE-bench Verified 35.8% is read from the chart in the Sept 2024 o1 system card (5-try Agentless scaffold, n=477 subset; taken as the post-mitigation bar, which beats GPT-4o's 33.2%), so the bar assignment is moderately confident. Parameters and compute undisclosed; Epoch's notes guess 60-120B total params and compute under 1e25 FLOP, which is speculative, so both are left null. Arena Elo 1305 is o1-mini on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off).

Full o1 launched 2024-12-05 in ChatGPT (Plus/Team, and ChatGPT Pro at $200/month with o1 pro mode); the API snapshot o1-2024-12-17 followed on 2024-12-17 at $15 per 1M input and $60 per 1M output. MMLU 91.8 and GPQA Diamond 75.7 are simple-evals (o1-2024-12-17); HumanEval is not reported ('-'; MATH-500 96.4). SWE-bench Verified 40.9% is o1 post-mitigation in the Dec 5 system card (5-try Agentless; o1-preview 41.3 there). OpenAI's o3 announcement chart later showed o1 at ~48.9% with a different setup (not re-verified). Not added as a model: o3, announced 2024-12-20 as a preview only (public release came in 2025): ARC-AGI-1 semi-private 75.7% at low compute and 87.5% at high compute (172x), checked against the ARC Prize post; SWE-bench Verified 71.7% and GPQA Diamond 87.7% as quoted from OpenAI's livestream by press (sources disagree on the SWE-bench figure). Params and compute undisclosed. Arena Elo 1352 is o1-2024-12-17 on the LMArena snapshot of 2025-01-24 (default view, style control off; rank 6 there, rank 1 with style control).

caveats: Changes vs the draft. (1) Arena Elo now comes from ONE snapshot: the LMArena text leaderboard, default view (style control off), as mirrored by the HF dataset mathewhe/chatbot-arena-elo at git tag 20250124 (tag 20250116 agrees within 1 point). Values: gpt-4-0314 1186, gpt-3.5-turbo-0314 1107 (was 1106), gpt-4-1106-preview 1250 (was 1251), gpt-4o-2024-05-13 1285, gpt-4o-mini 1273, o1-preview 1335, o1-mini 1305 (was 1306), o1-2024-12-17 1352 (was 1351). Mixed Sept-2024 / Dec-2023 / Mar-2024 sources were dropped. Estimated rows (never on Arena): GPT-1 550, GPT-2 650, GPT-3 800 (was 780; parity with raw LLaMA-13B = 800 on that snapshot), Codex 750, InstructGPT 920, text-davinci-003 960, ChatGPT 1090. (2) Codex note corrected: 77.5% is Codex-S pass@100 with an oracle, not an oracle-free reranking (mean-log-prob selection gives 44.5%). (3) ChatGPT trainFlop filled with Epoch's speculative GPT-3.5 series estimate 2.578e24 (the draft wrongly said Epoch has no GPT-3.5 row); gpt-3.5-turbo stays null (Epoch gives no compute, and its ~20B param source was reportedly retracted). (4) Removed unsupported or unverifiable statements: simple-evals 'ChatGPT-prompt row' for GPT-4o (README now lists only assistant-prompt rows, and the launch-blog numbers match Meta's Llama 3.1 table), the 'later free users' claim for o1-mini, the Codeforces-contamination remark for GPT-4, and 'training tokens ~499B' for GPT-3 (it trained on ~300B tokens from a ~499B mix). (5) Verified against primary text: GPT-2 LAMBADA 63.24 / CoQA 55 F1, MMLU Table 1 (GPT-2 32.4 fine-tuned, GPT-3 43.9 5-shot), GPQA Table 6 (GPT-3.5 28.1 and GPT-4 35.7 zero-shot CoT), GPT-4 report Table 2 and contamination Table 11, o1 system cards (SWE-bench), simple-evals rows, CoT Hub rows, Llama 3.1 Table 2, and Epoch params/compute/dates (GPT-1 1.7578e19, GPT-2 1.92e21, GPT-3 3.14e23, Codex 7.344e22, InstructGPT 3.19e23, GPT-4 2.1e25, GPT-4 Turbo 2.2e25, GPT-4o 3.8e25, GPT-4o mini 7.36e24). (6) Added text-davinci-003 (2022-11-28, $20/1M, MMLU 64.6) as a missing GPT-3.5-series milestone; o3 stays out (public release 2025). (7) Naming rule applied to descriptor words: Turbo->Turbu, Preview->Previow, text->Tixt, with ids updated (gtp-3-5-turbu, gtp-4-turbu, q1-previow, tixt-davanci-003). Remaining gaps: GPT-3's per-engine price at the Oct 2020 paid start and later gpt-3.5-turbo price cuts are from memory; GPT-2 1.5B date (2019-11-05) is from press because openai.com returned 403; the o3 SWE-bench figure varies by source; InstructGPT scores are for the later text-davinci-002 snapshot; GPT-3.5 benchmark rows (ChatGPT, gpt-3.5-turbo) share the GPT-4 report baseline; the seven estimated Elo values are game-balance numbers. Design note: .kiro design.md anchors a no-RLHF 'GTP-3-like' player model at Elo 930-1000, while this catalog's real GPT-3 base estimate is 800.
